title: Why Does a Pressure Cooker Cook So Fast?
short_title: Why a pressure cooker cooks faster
description: Why does a pressure cooker cook food so fast? The simple science of pressure and boiling point.
tags: how does a pressure cooker work
comment: How many whistles for dal? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does a pressure cooker cook food so fast?
In an open pot, water boils at about one hundred degrees, and cannot get hotter.
A sealed cooker traps the steam, so the pressure rises, and water boils at around one hundred and twenty degrees.
Hotter water and steam cook food faster, saving time and gas.
The whistle lets out extra steam, to keep the pressure safe.
And always let the pressure drop before opening the lid.
